title: What one run of agentic-report touches
description: The terminal starts the CLI; the CLI reads and writes the source folder, writes one page, and opens it in Chromium to take snapshots.
origin: Timed on 27 September 2026 on an Apple M4 Pro with Node.js 24.20 and the CLI of version 0.17.0 already installed: init, validate, build and snapshot ran one after another in an empty folder. Seconds count from the start of the run; a first npx run adds the download.

panels.label: agentic-report
panels.meaning: the tool this page is about

events.title: init
events.text: The landing starter is written into `./launch`: the page in English and Russian and the brief to fill in first.

events.title: validate
events.text: The source is checked without writing anything: every directive, every attribute, every link. It passes in 2.3 seconds.

events.title: build
events.text: **One file of 633 476 bytes.** Fonts, the runtime and both languages are inside it; it opens from disk without a server.

events.title: snapshot
events.text: Chromium opens the page at 390, 768 and 1440 pixels, light and dark, with motion and without it.

events.title: contact sheet
events.text: Twelve snapshots land on one contact sheet. This is the moment to look at the page before handing it over.
